command.doomscroll.admin.help.title: §6[doomscroll] Server settings — each line: command, what it does, current value
command.doomscroll.admin.help.lockdown: §7emergency shutdown: blacks out every screen at once and stops any from being turned on
command.doomscroll.admin.help.blackout: §7black out every screen once, without locking them (players can turn them back on)
command.doomscroll.admin.help.block: §7this domain and its subdomains can never be opened on a screen
command.doomscroll.admin.help.allow: §7while empty everything is allowed; once it has entries, only those can be opened
command.doomscroll.admin.help.private_ne: §7allow local network addresses (192.168.x, localhost). Keep it OFF: otherwise someone can put a router page on a screen
command.doomscroll.admin.help.consent: §7a page outside the allow list is not loaded until the viewer taps Show; nothing is requested from the site before that
command.doomscroll.admin.help.cookies: §7run screens on cookies separate from each player's saved logins (someone else's page cannot see your session)
command.doomscroll.admin.help.show_domai: §7show the real domain on the HUD when looking at a screen (a fake sign-in page cannot hide it)
command.doomscroll.admin.help.audit: §7who opened which address, when and where: the last n entries
command.doomscroll.admin.help.audit_log: §7whether that log is written to disk
command.doomscroll.admin.help.max_screen: §7how many screen blocks one player may place (0 = unlimited)
command.doomscroll.admin.help.cooldown: §7minimum gap between one player's address changes (0 = none)
command.doomscroll.admin.help.control_ti: §7how long a quiet controller keeps control of a screen
command.doomscroll.admin.help.broadcast: §7broadcast mode: one player's view is relayed to everyone, about 150 KB/s of server traffic per viewer
command.doomscroll.admin.help.pointer: §7whether players see each other's cursors on a screen
command.doomscroll.admin.help.redstone: §7whether a redstone signal may toggle screens
command.doomscroll.admin.help.announce: §7the “X opened this site on the screen” notice
command.doomscroll.admin.help.light: §7block light emitted by a screen that is on (needs a restart)
command.doomscroll.admin.help.perms: §8Permission nodes (with LuckPerms or similar): doomscroll.place, .url, .broadcast, .bypass, .admin   ·   every command also has a Turkish name (acil, karart, kayit, onay, cerez ...)
command.doomscroll.linkparty_off: /ds play is off: on first use it downloads and installs yt-dlp and ffmpeg from GitHub, and it only works on Windows. Set linkParty to true in config/doomscroll.json to enable it.
